raw_text:
Kotlin Multiplatform OO wrapper for Vulkan 1.4; handle types have RAII wrappers. Uses exceptions and context parameters for scoped memory. Goal: full Vulkan API/extensions coverage except deprecated or intentionally unsupported: render passes/framebuffers, custom memory allocators, raytracing.

Modules/libraries: kotlinx-datetime, kotlinx-io, volk, volk-kotlin (Kotlin/Native C-interop for Vulkan/Volk), vulkan-kotlin (KMP Vulkan wrapper), sample app. Targets modern desktop/mobile GPUs; minimum driver Vulkan 1.3. Supports `VK_KHR_dynamic_rendering`, `VK_KHR_dynamic_rendering_local_read`, `VK_EXT_extended_dynamic_state2`, `VK_KHR_synchronization2`.

Sort class functions by visibility (public then private), then lexicographically. `Device` is factory for most classes requiring `VkDevice`. When native memory allocation is required inside a function, `NativePlacement` should be passed as a context parameter. The caller is responsible for handling the allocation and freeing the memory. When the same functionality is available both in core and as an extension, the core functionality must be used. Every `public` class, function and property must have a KDoc.

Run tests and static analysis: `./gradlew check`
